text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a rookie trainer, there is so much to learn, making the days surprisingly hectic.
That day, as I walked along looking down at my paperwork—
LOOK OUUUUUUUUT!!

text_block_list.name: Energetic Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Ah, so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...A horsegirl sprinted right past right before my eyes.
If I hadn't stopped, we would have collided full-on...

You okay?!
No looking down while walking! You're not hurt, right?!
choice_data_list: Sorry... and thank you. Uh, you are...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory!
Head of Tracen Academy's—Disciplinary Committee!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Keep your eyes forward from now on! Watch where you're going!
Use the hallways with safety, security, and full-throttle energy! Dismissed!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Embodying the unspoken academy motto of 'Hallways are for running,'
Bamboo Memory bolted off down the corridor.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, she's a pre-debut trainee.
Having been saved by her was some twist of fate—maybe I should keep an eye on her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later—
After classes, I spotted Bamboo Memory doing warm-ups out on the grounds.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right, looking solid today too!!
Thank you very much, Instructor!!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thorough stretches as always. Now then, I have to go check on
the other girls... so please make sure not to overwork yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Instructors are responsible for supervising dozens of horsegirls at once.
The time they can dedicate to any single individual is inevitably limited.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: So, following protocol, the instructor walked away—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
28, 29, 30!
All right, next! Eight sets to go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet Bamboo Memory threw herself into the basic, tedious drills
exactly as instructed, without a single complaint.
choice_data_list: (She's so earnest and meticulous with her drills...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Many horsegirls love running so much that they neglect the fundamentals.
Even more so when practicing on their own.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hup, hup, hup, hup—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After an exhaustive warm-up, Bamboo Memory took off
onto the dirt track.
choice_data_list: (What a powerful stride built for dirt! And yet...)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Push further!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Somehow, it looked as though her sights were set on somewhere even further beyond.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo-san, it's about time to pack up.
It's getting late, so let's call it a day.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for your hard work, Instructor!
Do you have a second today?!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Instructor
text_block_list.text: Yes, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Just one lap is fine—I wanna run all-out on the turf track!!
I'm in top form today, and look, my hooves are totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Instructor
text_block_list.text:
...It's true, there doesn't seem to be an issue right now. That said, as an instructor,
all I can offer is general advice. Are you all right with that?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Totally fine! Please, I'd really appreciate it!!
All right! Here I goooo!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*... *pant*...... hah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory tore through the turf training track.
Powerful yet feather-light—an astounding display of speed.
choice_data_list: (Wait, isn't she actually better suited for turf...?!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Why dirt? It was a run that made me wonder,
exhibiting an undeniable affinity for turf.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
See?! Look, Instructor!!
My hooves don't hurt, and there isn't a single crack!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
With this, for the upcoming Events Tournament!!
Don't you think I could enter the turf division?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Events Tournament—a major bi-annual festival held at Tracen Academy.
Every student can register and compete in whatever events they choose.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even pre-debut trainees can clash with experienced upperclassmen.
It draws massive attention from outside the academy... an invaluable opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Instructor
text_block_list.text:
...I won't forbid it, but I still cannot recommend it.
Your hooves are inherently more fragile than most, Bamboo-san.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: No way, they've been super stable lately, haven't they?!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Instructor
text_block_list.text:
If you increase turf training—which puts far more strain on your hooves than dirt—
someone would need to constantly monitor their condition.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Instructor
text_block_list.text:
If that were possible, it might work... but in my position as an instructor,
I cannot devote myself entirely to you.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Instructor
text_block_list.text:
...The decision is yours, but... I believe it would be wiser to steadily build your body for now
and aim to transition to turf after your debut.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. In that case, for now!
For now, I'll stick to dirt training as usual.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But... I still don't wanna give up completely
on running turf in the next tournament. I'm sorry, Instructor!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Instructor
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Just make sure you do not overwork yourself.
Now then, shall we clean up?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: YES, MA'AM!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Many horsegirls dream of switching from dirt to turf. With more prestigious races and far greater attention, the turf route undeniably holds an advantage.
choice_data_list: But why rush it for the Division Meet...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Considering the condition of her hooves, the safest route would be to ease into it gradually just like the instructor said, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Is there something so important that she's willing to overlook the risk...? No matter how much I pondered it, I couldn't find a clear answer that day.
